name: medisync
description: Smart medicine reminder and medication adherence monitoring platform with notification escalation

scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev --include=optional && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,worker,client" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run worker --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
